annotations.title: A team's win rate and counts

description: Works out one number for any covered team, in any league or season, in code from its recorded lines: `win_rate`, `win_count`, `loss_count` or `match_count`. Call it whenever you would state a count, an average or a win rate, and quote its value exactly rather than working one out. With no `phase` it counts the playoffs and sectionals too, so pass phase:'regular season' for a league record alone.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

kind.description: Which number to compute, over the lines the team played: 'win_rate' (the share of them won, from 0 to 1), 'win_count' (lines won), 'loss_count' (lines lost) or 'match_count' (lines played).

phase.description: Optional competition phase: 'sectionals', 'playoffs', 'postseason', or 'regular season'. Pass it when the member names one, or when they ask for a LEAGUE record — a sectional match keeps its REGULAR-SEASON league name in our data, so there is no other way to separate them. Omit to count every phase.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

team.description: Team key or display name. Or the team's Desk page link or number.
